routes.authoritative_source: effect_reservations + effect terminal receipt when promoted
verified prediction/outcome + causal_credit_receipts + admitted semantic record/receipt

routes.rule: graph result may nominate candidates but must be revalidated against authoritative rows before effect/learning authority
assemble only task-relevant state with epoch/provenance/support references; no raw whole-store dump
KEEP_ISOLATED physically; persist cryptographic/content identity plus verification provenance into UnifiedDB

selection_integrity: Selection/ranking provenance is stored separately from record provenance. A selected row does not gain epistemic/effect authority from ranking.
cross_splice_defense: Terminalization query must join through identities proving one causal chain, not independently validate unrelated existing rows.
fallback: If exact identity/epoch/provenance is absent or stale, return BLOCKED/UNKNOWN and require reconciliation; never guess by nearest graph/vector match.
